text: Not too much for the runner: it has plenty of CPU and memory, and the scan is mostly waiting on the network. Today the live features all run on your phone, and the engine only does the regular scan, bets and bids. Two parts are different. The tail bettor needs no Pinnacle price, only Novig's live books, which the engine already reads with its own read key, so it can move to GitHub. The Pinnacle-based live taker and live bids need the Pinnodds socket. That key allows one connection and stays on the phone, and your rule is never to put it in a secret. The 5-second freshness rule also fails if the price makes a runner-to-GitHub-to-phone hop. So the plan is to move the tail bettor to the engine first, and the others only if you say to put the Pinnodds key on GitHub. This is logged as TCL108. I'll study the tail bettor move now and tell you what I find.
